ModMetaData.name: Lightweight Ammunition
ModMetaData.author: Mobivis
ModMetaData.description:
This mod adds lightweight ammunition made from commonly used raw resources, giving you more ammunition without the heavy Mass of carrying the raw resources.

Pure XML. No assemblies, ticking, Harmony patches, or unnecessary systems and bloat.

TL;DR: Lightweight ammunition for vehicle mods & turrets, letting you carry more ammo without worrying about Mass & storage space.
